tool.name: Pretext-to-asm
tool.command: mkdir -p 'pretext_to_asm_out' && pretext-to-asm -a '${input_fasta}' -p '${input_agp}' -o 'pretext_to_asm_out/pretext_galaxy.fa' -c '${opt.prefix}' #if $clobber --clobber #else --no-clobber #end if #if str($map_order) != "" --default-assembly-name '${map_order}' #end if #if $opt.no_max_contig_length --no-max-contig-length #else --max-contig-length '${opt.max_contig_length}' #end if

param.name: map_order
param.label: Name for output files which are not split per haplotype
param.help: Defaults to 'map-order' if the '--keep-map-order' option is given.

param.name: max_contig_length
param.label: Maximum length for a single contig
param.help: If a contig exceeds this size, it will be broken at gaps into a number of pieces such that each is less than this number. The pieces will have the suffixes '_1', '_2' etc.. added to their names. [default: 2 Gbp]

tool.help:
pretext-to-asm_ Uses fragments in the assembly (AGP) produced by PretextView to find matching fragments in the assembly which was fed into Pretext and output an assembly made from the input assembly fragments.
.. _pretext-to-asm: https://github.com/sanger-tol/agp-tpf-utils
